content: Cigar Register is a standalone desktop software application designed specifically for Windows operating systems, catering to the needs of cigar collectors. This software allows users to access detailed information about cigars, manage their humidors, organize their cigar collections, track their shopping history, maintain a wishlist, and document their smoking experiences along with personal reviews. The software is available for free download from its official website. The software includes a comprehensive cigar database, which is searchable and provides detailed information on over 3,800 cigars, including specifics about tobacco leaves, series, and brands. Users can utilize this database to learn about various cigar brands or as a reliable reference tool for daily use. The My Cigars feature enables users to add their humidors and compile their current cigar collection using the database. It also allows users to monitor their shopping and humidor history, record temperature and humidity levels, and create a wishlist by selecting their favorite cigars. The Smokeroom feature is designed to help users document their smoking experiences in detail. It provides the ability to browse through these records later using filters such as a calendar. Users can also assign their own ratings to the cigars they smoke, creating a personalized record of their preferences and experiences. The software is user-friendly, featuring large icons, customizable measurement units, drag-and-drop functionality, and a standard Windows software interface. These design elements ensure that users can quickly learn and enjoy the software's features with minimal effort.
